How to Process an Order Cancellation

Responsible Teams and Roles
Operations Analysts, Customer Support, Finance

Order Cancellation Playbook

Purpose
This playbook describes how to cancel customer orders before fulfillment is irreversible while ensuring inventory, payment, and customer communication are handled correctly.

When to Use
Use this playbook for customer-requested cancellations, fraud-related cancellations, inventory-driven cancellations, and internal order correction scenarios.

Responsible Roles
Primary owner: Operations Analyst or Customer Support agent with cancellation permissions.
Supporting roles: Warehouse team, Finance, Fraud Operations.
Approver: Team Lead for exceptions or high-value orders.

Procedure
Step 1: Verify customer identity, order number, and requested cancellation scope, including whether it is full or partial.
Step 2: Check the order state in the order management system to determine whether cancellation is still technically possible.
Step 3: Review payment capture status, fraud holds, and any downstream warehouse or shipping actions already triggered.
Step 4: If partial cancellation is requested, validate bundle rules, promotion impact, and shipping threshold changes.
Step 5: If the order exceeds the high-value threshold or includes regulated items, escalate for review before executing cancellation.
Step 6: Apply the correct cancellation code, item disposition, and customer-facing reason in the order system.
Step 7: Confirm payment reversal, void, or refund path is triggered correctly and log any exception requiring Finance follow-up.
Step 8: Release or correct inventory reservation to prevent stock distortion.
Step 9: Notify the customer of the final status, including refund timing if applicable.
Step 10: Document the cause, action taken, and any system inconsistency needing investigation.

Approval Requirements
Orders above $500 require lead review before cancellation unless fraud rules automatically cancel them.
Orders involving regulated goods require specialist review.
Finance review is required when payment capture does not reverse as expected.

Completion Criteria
The cancellation is complete when the order state is updated, payment handling is confirmed, inventory is corrected, and the customer has been notified.
